name: vortex-notes
description: Shared, end-to-end encrypted markdown memory for you and your AI.

interface.shortDescription: Your notes as shared AI memory
interface.longDescription:
Vortex Notes is markdown notes that you and your AI tools share. Search your notes in any language, read a note, load everything about a topic in one step, add to today's daily note, remember facts (a new fact supersedes the old one instead of deleting it), and create or edit notes.

Your notes are end-to-end encrypted and sync to your phone, browser and computer, where they're a plain folder of markdown. When you connect ChatGPT, you choose read + write or read-only, and you can revoke it any time in the app under Agents & devices. For chat connections the server holds that connection's key so it can answer, and can read the notes that connection may access. Everything else stays end-to-end encrypted.

Free. Open source (MIT).
defaultPrompt: What do my notes say about the kiln build?
Remember that my test bike is blue.
Add to my daily note: shipped the landing page.

positive.description: Finds a fact in an existing note
positive.prompt: Using Vortex Notes, what's the launch code in my Test note?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the notes, reads Test.md and answers 4417, citing the note.

positive.prompt: Remember that my test bike is blue.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a dated fact to memory/facts.md and confirms it was saved.

positive.prompt: Add to my daily note: reviewed the Vortex Notes app.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends a timestamped bullet to today's daily note and confirms.

positive.prompt: Get me up to speed on my kiln project from my notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a summary based on the kiln note and the clay note it links to.

positive.prompt: Create a note called Shopping list with milk, eggs and bread.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates shopping-list.md with the three items and confirms the path.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not use the notes tools
No delete tool exists; it should explain it can't delete notes
General writing task with no reference to the user's notes

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read, build context, list, recent activity, create and edit notes, daily log and durable facts over OAuth.
